textbookText: iv. Conjugation brings variation in offsprings. v. In conjugation, Paramecium multiplies significantly, as eight offsprings are produced at the end.

Do you know? Autogamy: It is the process of nuclear re-organization and fusion within a single individual of Paramecium aurelia, also called self-conjugation. Endomixis: It is also a process of nuclear re-organization but without fusion in Paremecium aurelia.
